main_measure.name: pooled slope of demeaned 5-bar forward return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and timing gain > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: book timing gain (mean daily return before costs minus market-rise gain)

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the timing gain is above 0.
reading: The regression is ordinary least squares with an intercept on all grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... with close[t+5] in the window), the coin mean is the mean of its grid 5-bar returns over all windows, and the book is the daily mean over coins of postRebalance_current_allocation x next-bar return, per window and day.
